summary: This Form 6-K furnishes routine annual general meeting materials: notice, proxy statement, employee incentive plan, and amended articles. Proposals include auditor appointment, director re-elections, and a share consolidation (8:1 reverse split) along with new share plan adoption. There are no acquisition, divestiture, activist, strategic review, tender offer, going-private, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC, or forced management change events. The filing is a standard current report of an ordinary shareholder meeting. What to watch: none—purely administrative governance items.
